goal: Restore the event detail page UI so it follows the previous approved design instead of a collapsed layout.

success_criteria.description: GET /app/events/event_001 renders the approved event detail hierarchy with hero, schedule, attendee or relationship context, registration action, and supporting detail sections visible without a collapsed-only layout.
Desktop and mobile page tests assert that primary event details, registration controls, and relationship context are visible, non-overlapping, and reachable without hidden collapsed defaults.
The route view model preserves existing event-detail data shape, empty, pending, and failure boundaries while restoring the presenter structure.
The implementation keeps no-write behavior during page render and does not add ticketing, payment, notification, calendar, or message side effects.
The event detail documentation records the restored layout contract and the regression test that prevents future collapse regressions.

out_of_scope: Adding event registration question logic beyond existing entry points
